name: Kiyohiro
source:
A dedicated ninja of Iga, emotionally inexpressive and uninterested in love.
Serves the [url=/c70103]Tokugawa[/url] and [url=/c70217]Hattori[/url] clans, as well as [url=/c69973]Saizou[/url].
